name: Moments That Made Them
positioning: Turning points of famous careers, original typography/illustration only (no clips, no likeness), every fact >= 2 sources

data.strategy: Shorts only, 38-48 s (max 55), 1/day to start. Named sports stars and household names with a PEG (award, release, anniversary, record <= 14 d) or proven search demand; one number that does not fit + a dated turn (turning-point micro-story). Original narration + typography only: no clips, no likeness, no silhouettes; every fact >= 2 sources. No long videos.
data.titleStyle: Named star + the number or oddity ("Messi Won 2 Golden Balls. 2026 Went to Rodri"); never "Explained", "in 60 Seconds", "N Turning Points". Overrides the old "The Night X Became X" pattern.
data.thumbnail: Frame 0 = giant gold number/claim on near-black, year stamp; no face, no silhouette
data.rightsPolicy: No third-party footage/audio. Images only from licensed/press-kit sources logged in assets table.
data.origin: merged from the old explainer studio (video-automation) 2026-11-02
data.engine: celebrity:build (tech builder with celebrity palette/voice; docs/brands/celebrity/build.md). Old HyperFrames spec engine stays archived.
